description.en: An APS-C X-mount camera used as a concrete sensor-dimension example, not as a generic definition of every APS-C camera.
description.zh-cn: 一台采用 APS-C 传感器的 X 卡口相机，用于提供具体尺寸示例，不代表所有 APS-C 相机的统一尺寸。

value.zh-cn: 可换镜头 · X 卡口

en: Its 23.5 × 15.7 mm sensor is one real APS-C example, not a universal APS-C dimension. Use it to distinguish physical size, crop factor, and equivalent field of view.
The official specification lists a five-axis sensor-shift stabilization mechanism. It can compensate for some camera motion; it cannot freeze a moving subject.
JPEG, HEIF, RAW, and TIFF are listed separately. RAW conversion and EXIF metadata are not interchangeable with the image encoding itself.
zh-cn: 23.5 × 15.7 mm 传感器是一个真实的 APS-C 示例，不是所有 APS-C 的统一尺寸。可用它区分物理尺寸、画幅系数和等效视角。
官方规格列出五轴传感器位移防抖机构。它可补偿部分相机运动，但不能凝固移动的主体。
JPEG、HEIF、RAW 和 TIFF 分别列出。RAW 转换与 EXIF 元数据都不能和图像编码本身混为一谈。
